steps.label: wait-fonts
steps.expr: (async () => { await document.fonts.ready; return { fonts: document.fonts.status, loaded: document.fonts.size }; })()

steps.label: SETTLED-baseline
steps.expr: (() => ({ h: document.documentElement.scrollHeight, turnstileH: (document.querySelector('.cf-turnstile')||{}).offsetHeight ?? null, submitTop: Math.round(document.querySelector('button[type=submit]').getBoundingClientRect().top), submitBottom: Math.round(document.querySelector('button[type=submit]').getBoundingClientRect().bottom), submitVisibleNoScroll: (()=>{const r=document.querySelector('button[type=submit]').getBoundingClientRect(); return r.top>=0 && r.bottom<=window.innerHeight;})() }))()

steps.label: after-1-char
steps.expr: (() => ({ h: document.documentElement.scrollHeight, strengthRendered: !!document.querySelector('.animate-scale-in'), active: document.activeElement.id, activeInViewport: (()=>{const r=document.activeElement.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.top>=0 && r.bottom<=window.innerHeight;})() }))()

steps.label: after-full-password
steps.expr: (() => ({ h: document.documentElement.scrollHeight, strengthText: (document.querySelector('.animate-scale-in')||{}).innerText?.replace(/\s+/g,' ').slice(0,40) ?? null, active: document.activeElement.id, activeInViewport: (()=>{const r=document.activeElement.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.top>=0 && r.bottom<=window.innerHeight;})() }))()

steps.label: after-email
steps.expr: (() => ({ h: document.documentElement.scrollHeight, active: document.activeElement.id, activeInViewport: (()=>{const r=document.activeElement.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.top>=0 && r.bottom<=window.innerHeight;})() }))()

steps.label: SIGNIN-height
steps.expr: (() => ({ h: document.documentElement.scrollHeight, screens: +(document.documentElement.scrollHeight/window.innerHeight).toFixed(2), fields: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('input:not([type=hidden])')).map(i=>i.id), submitVisibleNoScroll: (()=>{const r=document.querySelector('button[type=submit]').getBoundingClientRect(); return r.top>=0 && r.bottom<=window.innerHeight;})() }))()

steps.label: RESET-height
steps.expr: (() => ({ h: document.documentElement.scrollHeight, screens: +(document.documentElement.scrollHeight/window.innerHeight).toFixed(2), fields: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('input:not([type=hidden])')).map(i=>i.id), hasTabs: !!document.querySelector('.grid.grid-cols-2'), backToSignIn: !!Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b=>/Back to sign in/.test(b.textContent)), submitVisibleNoScroll: (()=>{const r=document.querySelector('button[type=submit]').getBoundingClientRect(); return r.top>=0 && r.bottom<=window.innerHeight;})() }))()

steps.label: TABSWITCH-forgot
steps.expr: (() => ({ url: location.search, h: document.documentElement.scrollHeight, title: (document.querySelector('h1')||{}).innerText, desc: (document.querySelector('h1')?.parentElement?.querySelector('p:nth-of-type(2)')||{}).innerText?.slice(0,60) ?? null }))()

steps.label: TABSWITCH-create
steps.expr: (() => ({ url: location.search, h: document.documentElement.scrollHeight, title: (document.querySelector('h1')||{}).innerText, fields: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('input:not([type=hidden])')).map(i=>i.id) }))()
